Refuse actual upstream execution outside explicit fresh GitHub-hosted Linux/Windows Node 24 context. Separate lane homes/state/cache and validate directory ownership. Guard is not an OS sandbox.

Use npm ci with lifecycle scripts disabled. Both locks contain ripgrep1.18.0 prebuilt optional packages; remove the unnecessary rebuild, verify the exact native binary version/hash/path, and disclose npm/Chrome networking.
Restore all 16 unrelated native libc selectors dropped by npm lock regeneration. All other existing unrelated lock entries remain identical.
Independent review identified three false-positive proof weaknesses. Add actual failing counterexamples before tightening blocklist, configuration and output-tail assertions.
Canonicalize ordinary temporary path aliases after rejecting every actual link/junction ancestor, retaining source/store separation and pinned ownership.
Record bounded search state/count observations and specific assertion codes to diagnose the failed hosted comparison without exposing arbitrary response content.
Count published UUID.json heartbeat records rather than concurrent atomic-write temporary files in the existing shared-admission fixture and new probe.
